_comment: Implementation-stage classification declarations for the throwaway v2-1-dry-run-legacy item, created solely to exercise D-Legacy phase 2 (WF-M8b) adoption for real during WF8b's S11 dry-run scenario (docs/ai-workflow/dry-run/WF8B_SCENARIOS.md). This item has no real implementation deliverable of its own -- protected sets are intentionally empty and every real repository path is excluded by top-level prefix/path, mirroring milestone-8-artifacts.json's own widened-at-adoption-time shape (D-Legacy phase 2's own reasoning: a dormant legacy item must not be staled by a concurrent work item's own ordinary commits). Its own reviewed_content_commit (dc4381a348c114ec4967174c4e6a76ac00b1a537, milestone-8's round-4-approved commit) equals its base_commit by construction, so at import time this item's manifest was trivially empty regardless of this file's exclusion breadth; the breadth here exists for WF-M8b's later any_protected_path_changed_since(reviewed_content_commit, HEAD, ...) freshness re-check, which fails closed (UnclassifiedPathError) on any changed path neither set names. Never consumed by any live plan-stage bundle (this item never runs /milestone-plan); removed entirely, along with the work_items entry it classifies for, as part of WF8b's S17 cleanup.
